description: Autoritatea contractantă va încheia acorduri-cadru de prestare a serviciilor de întreținere și reparații instalații speciale ce se află montate pe autospecialele de intervenție și salvare de la înălțimi din parcul auto al I.S.U. Teleorman pentru o perioadă de 12 de luni, împărțind în acest sens achiziția în 2 loturi, astfel încât să corespundă mai bine necesităților autorității contractante, precum și capacității operatorilor economici. Autoritatea contractantă este interesată să achiziționeze atât piesele de schimb și materialele necesare pentru procesul de reparare și întreținere a instalațiilor speciale, cât și serviciile menționate, acestea efectuându-se în atelierele specializate ale operatorilor economici câștigători. În derularea acordurilor-cadru se va avea în vedere faptul că orice serviciu de mentenanță preventivă și/sau corectivă va fi achiziționat doar în baza unui contract subsecvent, semnat de către reprezentanții legali ai părților, în limita fondurilor bugetare alocate. Ofertanții pot depune oferta de preț pentru unul sau mai multe loturi, detaliat pe fiecare tip/marcă de instalație specială solicitat de către autoritatea contractantă, conform specificațiilor caietului de sarcini. Operatorii economici trebuie să facă dovada că dețin cel puțin un atelier specializat sau că au încheiate acorduri de asociere sau subcontractare cu operatori economici autorizați să execute servicii ce fac obiectul contractului. În situații în care, după atribuirea contractului, fondurile alocate sunt sub pragurile estimate, autoritatea contractantă nu-și asumă obligația de a executa reparațiile curente și reviziile tehnice la valoarea maximă prezentată în fișa de date. Acordul-cadru, ca modalitate specială de atribuire a unui contract de achiziție publică, conține cantități estimate de produse și servicii pe care autoritatea contractantă consideră că le va achiziționa ulterior, cantități care apar la nivelul documentației de atribuire a respectivului acord-cadru, autoritatea contractantă având obligația, ulterior, la momentul încheierii contractelor subsecvente, de a stabili cantitățile fixe ce vor fi achiziționate în baza respectivului contract subsecvent. Serviciile și produsele de mentenanță preventivă și corectivă ce se vor achiziționa trebuie să îndeplinească în totalitate cerințele minime ale specificațiilor tehnice așa cum sunt prevăzute în caietul de sarcini. Cantitățile minime și maxime ale acordului-cadru, respectiv ale contractelor subsecvente, sunt menționate în caietul de sarcini.

title: FTA Broad Agency Announcement (FY26) -- �Research Initiatives in Support of Safety, Accessibility, and Mobility in Public Transportation
description: This Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) from the Federal Transit Administration (FTA) solicits applied research projects to improve the safety, reliability, efficiency, and accessibility of public transportation in the United States. Purpose: To solicit innovative applied research that reduces deployment risks, improves safety, lowers costs, and facilitates domestic transit manufacturing. Eligibility: This is an unrestricted solicitation; any responsible source (excluding Federal Government-owned businesses) may submit a concept paper. Teaming and collaboration are encouraged. Funding: Individual awards typically range between $150,000 and $500,000, subject to fund availability. While cost sharing is not always mandatory, projects including transit operator partnerships and cost sharing are preferred. Technology Readiness: Projects should focus on technology readiness levels (TRL) 3 through 6, with a preference for proof-of-concept testing (TRL 3).

title: " Ausbildung und Gestaltung von seitlichen Baustellenzuwegungen im Längsverkehr auf BAB "
description: Im Zuge der Durchführung von Bauarbeiten müssen regelmäßig Baustellenfahrzeuge, Transportfahrzeuge und Baumaschinen in den Arbeitsbereich ein- und ausfahren. Hierfür kommen insbesondere bei langen Baustellenabschnitten Baustellenzuwegungen innerhalb der Arbeitsstelle, d. h. im Längsverkehr der Autobahn, zum Einsatz. Solche Zuwegungen führen zu zusätzlichen Konfliktpunkten mit dem fließenden Verkehr, die die Verkehrssicherheit mindern bzw. zu Störungen im Verkehrsablauf führen können. Aktuell gibt es keine Standards für die Ausbildung und Gestaltung von solchen Baustellenzuwegungen. Während Baustellenzuwegungen in Regelwerken und Arbeitsschutzvorschriften grundsätzlich berücksichtigt werden, liegen bislang nur wenige wissenschaftlich fundierte Erkenntnisse zu deren sicherer und leistungsfähiger Gestaltung vor. Ziel dieses Forschungsvorhabens ist die systematische Untersuchung von Baustellenzuwegungen innerhalb von Arbeitsstellen längerer Dauer auf BAB sowie die Erarbeitung wissenschaftlich fundierter Empfehlungen für deren Planung, Gestaltung und Betrieb. Weiterhin sollen geeignete Bewertungsmaßstäbe entwickelt werden, mit denen die Eignung unterschiedlicher Lösungen hinsichtlich Verkehrssicherheit, Verkehrsablauf und Praktikabilität beurteilt werden kann. Als Ergebnis des Forschungsvorhabens sind Handlungsempfehlungen für die Planung, Ausschreibung, Genehmigung und den Betrieb von Baustellenzuwegungen im Längsverkehr zu erarbeiten. Es sind unter anderem Vorgaben zur geeigneten Lage, Entwicklungslänge, Beschilderung und Markierung sowie zu verkehrstechnischen Maßnahmen abgeleitet werden. Zudem sollen Vorschläge für die Fortschreibung bestehender Regelwerke, Leitfäden, Verordnungen und technischer Vorschriften abgeleitet werden (z. B. RSA, VwV StVO, ZTV SA). Das Vorhaben soll einen Beitrag zur sicheren, effizienten und regelwerkskonformen Abwicklung von Arbeitsstellen längerer Dauer auf hochbelasteten Bundesautobahnen leisten.

title: Energie-Geschäftsreiseprogramm im Rahmen der Exportinitiative Energie des BMWE 2027, 2. Tranche
description: Das Ziel der Exportinitiative Energie (EIE) des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Energie (BMWE) ist es, deutsche Unternehmen (UN), die klimafreundliche Energielösungen anbieten, beim Markteintritt im Ausland zu unterstützen und deutsche Produkte und Dienstleistungen international zu positionieren. Ein fester Bestandteil des Förderangebots ist das Energie-Geschäftsreiseprogramm. Ziel der Energie-Geschäftsreisen ist es, den Markteinstieg für deutsche KMU durch den Aufbau von fundierten Marktkenntnissen sowie die gezielte Kontaktvermittlung zu potenziellen Geschäftspartnern in den jeweiligen Zielmärkten vorzubereiten und bestehende Auslandsaktivitäten deutscher KMU weiter auszubauen. Das Fördermodul Energie-Geschäftsreise (GR) besteht aus einem Reisesteckbrief*, einer Zielmarktanalyse (ZMA*), einem Briefing vor Ort sowie einer Veranstaltung oder einer Kombination mehrerer Veranstaltungsformate*, die in Abhängigkeit von Zielmarkt und Themenschwerpunkt ausgewählt werden. Das zentrale Element der Maßnahme sind individuelle Gespräche der deutschen UN für eine gezielte Geschäftsanbahnung mit potenziellen Geschäftspartnern des Ziellandes.

description: Das Ziel der Exportinitiative Energie (EIE) des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Energie (BMWE) ist es, deutsche Unternehmen (UN), die klimafreundliche Energielösungen anbieten, beim Markteintritt im Ausland zu unterstützen und deutsche Produkte und Dienstleistungen international zu positionieren. Ein fester Bestandteil des Förderangebots ist das Energie-Geschäftsreiseprogramm. Das Fördermodul digitale Energie-Geschäftsreise (dGR) besteht aus einem Reisesteckbrief, einer Zielmarktanalyse (ZMA), einem Online-Briefing sowie einer online durchgeführten Fachkonferenz. Das zentrale Element der Maßnahme sind individuelle Gespräche der deutschen UN für eine gezielte Geschäftsanbahnung mit potenziellen Geschäftspartnerinnen und Gesprächspartnern des Ziellandes.

title: Germany – Architectural, engineering and planning services – Planungsleistungen Regenüberlaufbecken Dülmen-Tiberbach
description: Gegenstand des Auftrages sind Planungsleistungen für den Ersatzneubau des Regenüberlaufbeckens Tiberbach für die Leistungsbilder Ingenieurbauwerke (Leistungsphase 1 – 9, HOAI 2021), Tragwerksplanung (Leistungsphase 1 – 6, HOAI 2021), und Technische Ausrüstung (Leistungsphase 1 – 9, HOAI 2021). Das Regenüberlaufbecken Dülmen-Tiberbach ist Bestandteil des Mischwasserentwässerungssystems der Kläranlage Dülmen. Das bestehende Bauwerk ist als Rundbecken mit einem Speichervolumen von ca. 2.400 m³ ausgeführt. Im Rahmen wasserwirtschaftlicher Untersuchungen wurde festgestellt, dass die vorhandene Anlage sowohl baulichen Erneuerungsbedarf aufweist als auch hinsichtlich des erforderlichen Speichervolumens an die aktuellen Anforderungen der Mischwasserbehandlung anzupassen ist. Die Maßnahme umfasst die Planung eines neuen Regenüberlaufbeckens mit einem Speichervolumen von ca. 3.500 m³. Das neue Bauwerk soll südlich des bestehenden Regenüberlaufbeckens als Rechteckbecken errichtet werden. Weiterhin sind die erforderlichen Anpassungen der Zu- und Ablaufanlagen, die Planung eines neuen Trennbauwerks mit integrierter Rechenanlage, die Herstellung einer neuen Einleitungsstelle für den Klärüberlauf sowie die Planung und Herstellung der erforderlichen Schwallspülkippen zu berücksichtigen. Mit Trennbauwerk, Zulaufleitung und Verteilerkammer soll sich das Volumen auf insgesamt V = 3.700 m³ erhöhen. Darüber hinaus ist die Anbindung des neuen Regenüberlaufbeckens einschließlich der zugehörigen Anlagentechnik an das virtuelle Prozessleitsystem (vPLS) von EGLV zu planen. Der Rückbau des alten RÜBs ist ebenfalls zu beplanen.

title: Barn og unges digitale hverdag - i spennet mellom rettigheter, deltakelse, relasjoner og sosiale dynamikk
description: Formålet med forskningsprosjektet er å utvikle kunnskap om mangfoldet av barn og unges digitale hverdagsliv, og hvordan digitaliseringen påvirker deres fellesskap og muligheter for deltakelse i samfunnet. Et sentralt utgangspunkt er å belyse spenningen mellom deres rett til informasjon og deltakelse på nett på den ene siden, og retten til beskyttelse på nett på den andre. Denne spenningen gir opphav til dilemmaer i skjæringspunktet mellom individ og system, hvor hensynet til barns rettigheter må avveies mot behovet for personvern, regulering og kontroll. Videre skal prosjektet utforske dilemma knyttet til hvordan digitale medier inngår i barn og unges sosiale liv – både med jevnaldrende, foresatte, profesjonelle omsorgspersoner, og andre voksne. Digitale samhandlingsformer er integrert i relasjoner og sosiale sammenhenger, og kan bidra både positivt og negativt til tilhørighet, deltakelse og sosial dynamikk – både digitalt og analogt. Prosjektet skal derfor belyse hvorvidt og eventuelt hvordan digital samhandling former barn og unges relasjoner og sosiale dynamikker, og bidra til økt forståelse av disse prosessene og betydningen av dem. Samlet skal oppdraget bidra til økt innsikt i de relasjonelle og samfunnsmessige konsekvensene av en oppvekst der digitale og analoge arenaer er sammenvevd.

title: CivTech 12.1 - How can digital technologies assist people living with substance use issues (and their families/friends) to easily connect with trusted help and substance use support when services are unavailable?
description: Scotland has the highest drug and alcohol related death rates in the UK and Europe. People with substance use issues (PWSUI) often need help outside normal 'office' hours or from a distance from offices, and support is not uniformly available throughout Scotland. The support landscape in Scotland is fragmented, hard to navigate, and varies by locality. When support isn’t readily available (or isn’t trusted), people and their families and friends often default to emergency services or remain unsupported. As a result, those who use substances often experience avoidable crisis escalation, or remain in extremely difficult situations, and support services miss opportunities for early, harm-reducing interventions. The Preventing Harm, Promoting Recovery: Scotland’s Alcohol & Drugs Strategic Plan 2026 – 2035 specifically addresses the crucial need to tackle early intervention and widen an individual’s ‘circle of support’. This ‘circle of support’ is at the heart of this Challenge, and a successful solution would enable people to access the right support sooner, regardless of locality. It should harness the power of existing trusted services, family and community to reduce avoidable demand on emergency and NHS services – and if possible, create a ‘feedback loop’ of learning, intelligence and insight so that the overall issue can be tackled in a continually improving manner.

title: How can technology enable fast-growing digital public service providers to dynamically scale their service management capabilities as demand, complexity and customer expectations increase?
description: The Scottish Government’s Directorate for Digital is seeking an innovative service management solution to support a growing portfolio of digital services, including ScotAccount, ScotPayments, mygov.scot, Cloud Platform Services, and more. As demand, complexity and user expectations increase, we require scalable, technology-enabled approaches that can grow as our services grow, while delivering value for money. A successful solution will help ensure resilient, secure and efficient service operations, reducing risks to service quality, productivity, revenue and public trust, while supporting the future development of Scotland’s digital public services.

title: CivTech 12.5 - How can technology support multi agency processes for the protection of children in Scotland?
description: This Challenge presents an exciting opportunity to make a positive difference in protecting children in Scotland from harm, an area of the highest priority for the Scottish Cabinet and partners. Scotland’s child protection system relies on Inter-Agency Referral Discussions (IRDs) to make timely safeguarding decisions for children (over 17,000 IRDs took place during 2024-25). IRDs are effective and work well as a process, however they are currently supported by fragmented IT systems, manual processes and localised records. This results in duplication, delays, and barriers to information sharing across agencies and local authorities. These inefficiencies increase administrative burden, reducing time available for direct support to children and families. The Scottish Government, Police Scotland and the National Social Work Agency (TBC) are seeking innovative solutions that will enable secure streamlined multi-agency information sharing for the existing IRD process, as well as providing real-time local and national data to improve child protection outcomes across Scotland.

title: CivTech 12 - Challenge 12.3 - How can we use technology to demonstrate the commercial value of circular economy business practices?
description: Zero Waste Scotland is seeking an innovative technology solution that helps businesses demonstrate the commercial value of circular economy practices and attract investment. Existing assessment tools often overlook benefits including (but not limited to) supply chain resilience, resource security, customer retention and reduced exposure to market shocks. We are looking for an intuitive, evidence-based tool that integrates the wider benefits into business and investment decisions, while generating insights to inform future support and policy development. The solution should build business and investor confidence, help accelerate adoption of circular practices and support Scotland's transition to a sustainable, circular economy.

title: CivTech 12.6 - How can technology improve living conditions and quality of life for social housing residents in Scotland?
description: Cold homes, damp, mould and fuel poverty are driving poor health outcomes, increasing pressure on healthcare services and deepening inequalities. While Registered Social Landlords are investing in warmer, more energy-efficient housing and responding to new regulatory requirements, fuel poverty means many vulnerable residents remain at risk, even in high-quality homes. Current approaches are often reactive and lack mechanisms to target support for those that might be the very most vulnerable, addressing issues only after harm has occurred. This Challenge seeks innovative solutions that can help registered social landlords identify where housing conditions, fuel poverty and individual vulnerability combine to create the greatest risk of harm, then translate that insight into practical, targeted action that combats these impacts, improves tenants’ health and wellbeing outcomes, protects homes and makes better use of limited housing and support resources. Solutions must be affordable at RSL scale, protect tenant privacy, and connect insight to action so that Cloch can complete investigation and repair work within statutory timescales.

As demand, complexity and user expectations increase, we require scalable, technology-enabled approaches that can grow as our services grow, while delivering value for money. title: CivTech 12 - Challenge 12.4 - How can technology improve both the efficiency and the patient experience in NHS transport, starting with renal services?​
description: With over 273,000 people in Scotland living with Stage 3-5 Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD), including 2,000 receiving dialysis treatment, and demand expected to increase fivefold over the next decade, improvements to dialysis transport across NHS Scotland are urgently needed. Dialysis journeys account for more than 40% of all non-emergency patient transport activity, costing 9.1 million GBP annually. Yet current arrangements can be inconsistent, creating avoidable pressures for patients, providers and NHS services. NHS Scotland is seeking innovative, patient-centred and sustainable solutions that improve reliability, efficiency and patient outcomes, while reducing administrative burden and delivering better value for money.

title: Modular Wind Power for Northern Operations
description: This Challenge notice is issued under the Innovation for Defence Excellence and Security (IDEaS) Program Call for Proposals (CFP) Call 006 (W7714-248676/A). Solicitation Documents reference: See bidding details section. *For additional general information on the IDEaS Program, visit: https://www.canada.ca/en/department-national-defence/programs/defence-ideas.html _____________ This challenge is open to receive proposals for Component 1a, Component 1b and Component 2. Proposed solutions that fall within technology readiness levels (TRL) 1-9 can be submitted to this challenge. Steps to apply: Step 1: read this challenge Step 2: read the Call for Proposals : See bidding details section Step 3: propose your solution here : https://defence-innovation-portal.my.site.com/ _____________ Maximum Funding and Performance Period Multiple contracts could result from this Challenge. The individual maximum contract funding available under Component 1a (TRL 1-3) is up to $250,000 CAD (excluding applicable taxes) for a maximum performance period of up to 6 months. The maximum individual contract funding available under Component 1b (TRL 4-5) is up to $1,500,000 CAD (excluding applicable taxes) for a maximum performance period of 12 months. The maximum individual contract funding available under Component 2 (TRL 6-9) is up to $5,000,000 CAD (excluding applicable taxes). The period of performance will be determined at the time of contract negotiation. The maximum individual contractual funding and the maximum performance period offered under Component 3 will be determined by Canada at the time of contract negotiation. This disclosure is made in good faith and does not commit Canada to contract for the total approximate funding. _____________ Challenge Details Challenge Title: W7714-248676/016 - Modular Wind Power For North Operations The Department of National Defence and Canadian Armed Forces (DND/CAF) are seeking innovative solutions to develop modular, stand-alone wind-powered electric generator systems that can be easily transported, deployed, and maintained in remote northern locations to provide reliable, clean energy under extreme cold, high-wind, and icing conditions. Background & Context The demand for electrical power and space heating in the Canadian Subarctic and High Arctic is fulfilled almost exclusively with diesel-fired generators. The DND/CAF is seeking to reduce reliance on fossil fuels for the generation of electrical power in the North to minimize operational, logistical, and environmental burdens. Wind turbines suitable for DND/CAF operations are in limited use in the North, as existing installations tend to fall outside the desired capacity range. While small units that deliver up to 6 kilowatts (kW) have been deployed in some communities, and commercial turbines typically exceed 1 megawatt (MW), there is a critical gap in the 25–100 kW range—an ideal scale for remote DND sites. In addition, northern operating conditions present major technical and environmental hurdles that must be overcome before wind turbines can be fully exploited as a source of alternative energy. Canada's far North and Arctic regions are characterized by seasonally frozen ground, deep snow, rugged terrain, permafrost, and extreme temperatures that can reach –60 degrees Celsius (°C), with frequent high winds of 80–120 kilometers per hour (km/h). Ice rimming of wind turbine blades further threatens performance and efficiency. Innovative approaches are therefore needed to adapt conventional wind-powered electric generator designs to withstand these harsh northern conditions and operate effectively under both low and high wind scenarios. Climate change adds additional complexity, as thawing and refreezing permafrost can cause buildings and foundations to sink, shift, or crack. While not the primary focus of the challenge, consideration must be given to the design of the foundations to keep the turbines level and stable despite seasonal ground movement. There is a need for wind-powered electricity generators that are logistically efficient, easy to deploy, and maintainable in isolated northern locations. Many DND/CAF sites exist in remote areas or within small Arctic communities that have limited or no road access and must be reached by alternative means of transportation such as barges or heavy-lift aircraft. Consequently, new systems must feature modular designs that can be transported and assembled on site with minimal heavy-lift equipment by non-technicians using commonly available tools. To ensure sustained operation, proposed solutions should use readily available parts, be serviceable by local tradespeople, and operate with minimal human intervention once deployed. Essential Outcomes The proposed solution must: • Provide a design for a wind-powered electrical generation system in the 25–100 kW range, incorporating details of the structural, mechanical, electrical, and control elements required. • Provide integration and operational demonstration plan(s), showing how the wind-powered electric generator system can function in remote northern locations and operate and withstand northern environmental conditions, including extreme cold (down to –60 °C), high winds (up to 120 km/h), and icing conditions without intervention. • Integrate with existing electrical power systems or microgrids and must enable coordinated operation with other energy sources and support performance under varying generation and load conditions. • Use a modular design that allows transport by air or ship — ensuring that individual components fit within a standard 20ft sea container with maximum dimensions of 108 in. (2.74 m) wide × 268 in. (6.81 m) long × 96 in. (2.44 m) high and a maximum weight of 24,000 lb (10,886 kg; 10.9 tonnes). • The modular design must enable onsite assembly without the need for heavy lift equipment. • Support maintainability and repairability in northern environments by ensuring the wind powered electric generator system can be serviced using standard mechanical and electrical tools, without reliance on specialized proprietary equipment or manufacturer field support. Desired Outcomes Proposed solutions should include capabilities such as, but not limited to, the following: • Electromagnetic interference that complies with MIL STD 461G, Department of Defense Interface Standard for the Control of Electromagnetic Interference Characteristics of Subsystems and Equipment. • Foundation design that accounts for Arctic ground conditions, including permafrost, active-layer variation, and freeze-thaw effects, over the intended design life of the generator.

title: RF Data Fusion for Command and Control
description: This Challenge notice is issued under the Innovation for Defence Excellence and Security (IDEaS) Program Call for Proposals (CFP) Call 006 (W7714-248676/A). Solicitation Documents reference: See bidding details section. *For additional general information on the IDEaS Program, visit: https://www.canada.ca/en/department-national-defence/programs/defence-ideas.html _____________ This challenge is open to receive proposals for Component 1a, Component 1b and Component 2. Proposed solutions that fall within technology readiness levels (TRL) 1-9 can be submitted to this challenge. Steps to apply: Step 1: read this challenge Step 2: read the Call for Proposals : See bidding details section Step 3: propose your solution here : https://defence-innovation-portal.my.site.com/ _____________ Maximum Funding and Performance Period Multiple contracts could result from this Challenge. The individual maximum contract funding available under Component 1a (TRL 1-3) is up to $250,000 CAD (excluding applicable taxes) for a maximum performance period of up to 6 months. The maximum individual contract funding available under Component 1b (TRL 4-5) is up to $1,500,000 CAD (excluding applicable taxes) for a maximum performance period of 12 months. The maximum individual contract funding available under Component 2 (TRL 6-9) is up to $5,000,000 CAD (excluding applicable taxes). The period of performance will be determined at the time of contract negotiation. The maximum individual contractual funding and the maximum performance period offered under Component 3 will be determined by Canada at the time of contract negotiation. This disclosure is made in good faith and does not commit Canada to contract for the total approximate funding. _____________ Challenge Details Challenge Title: W7714-248676/017 - RF Data Fusion for Command and Control The Department of National Defence (DND) and the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) are seeking innovative software-based solutions to seamlessly convert, analyze, and fuse real-time, domain-specific, content-rich data transmitted over radio frequency (RF) bearers into a secure, standardized pan-domain Command and Control (C2) format to enhance interoperability and enable timely, data-driven decision-making across all domains and levels of command. Background and context Radio frequency (RF) communications in military operations are inherently bandwidth-constrained and vulnerable to jamming, interference, and environmental effects, making them unreliable in contested environments. To maintain timely and effective support across all warfighting domains, data transmitted over RF bearers should be transformed into compact, structured messages, such as eXtensible Markup Language (XML)-based Message Text Formats (MTF) or other machine-readable schemas. Such messages should be optimized for transmission over tactical networks including Low Frequency (LF), Very Low Frequency (VLF), High Frequency (HF), Ultra High Frequency (UHF), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM). This approach enables resilient, standards-based communication across domains (land, air, maritime, cyber, and space) and functional services (e.g., Joint Intelligence Surveillance and Reconnaissance (JISR), medical, logistics), in line with doctrinal requirements for pan-domain operations. CAF tactical messaging remains largely dependent on legacy systems. These systems are inflexible, poorly suited to machine-to-machine exchange, and increasingly misaligned with NATO’s shift toward XML-based, data-centric frameworks. CAF operators currently lack integrated, machine-readable messaging systems. As a result, they must manually convert voice, chat, and text inputs into formal military products including orders, situation reports, and Requests for Information (RFIs) to comply with command structures and coalition standards. Modern, pan-domain operations require that doctrinal and technical Information Exchange Requirements (IERs) be met at the speed of operational relevance, with messaging that is interoperable, standardized, and capable of supporting real-time, data-driven decision-making in joint and coalition environments. As NATO, the U.S. Department of Defense, and other Five Eyes partners adopt XML-based, machine-readable messaging frameworks, the CAF is prioritizing alignment with these emerging data models to improve interoperability, operational agility, and mission effectiveness. The DND/CAF are seeking innovative, interoperable, and scalable solutions that will contribute to the development of a next-generation digital military RF messaging and data exchange. Innovators are invited to propose technologies, platforms, or integrated systems. Essential Outcomes The proposed solution must: • Be a software-based capability (e.g., standalone application, plug-in, middleware, or service). • Support DND/CAF operations across all domains (land, air, maritime, space, cyber) and functional services (e.g., C2, intelligence, logistics). • Implement structured, standards-compliant messaging (e.g., MTF-XML) and data exchange protocols (e.g., National Information Exchange Model (NIEM), NATO Core Data Framework (NCDF)), with documented interfaces for importing, exporting, and exchanging data using those standards. • Be configurable and modular, supporting Character-Oriented Information Exchange (COIE) processing and designed for future extensibility (e.g., to accommodate emerging or disruptive standards). • Provide documented interfaces and standards-based data exchange mechanisms to support system integration, including use within experimentation, simulation, and wargaming environments. Desired Outcomes The proposed solution should include capabilities such as, but not limited to, the following: • Operability in Denied, Degraded, Intermittent, and Low Bandwidth (DDIL) environments, with scalability to support evolving mission requirements and force structures. • Enhanced user experience features such as intuitive interfaces, multilingual support, automation of routine workflows, and built-in decision aids. • Standardized, documented integration interfaces (e.g., application programming interfaces (APIs)) to enable integration with at least one Service Management or Service Monitoring tools or platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Splunk, Dynatrace, Microsoft System Center, Azure Monitor, etc.). • Readiness for future integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities to support data fusion, intelligent message prioritization, and real-time decision support.

The maximum individual contractual funding and the maximum performance period offered under Component 3 will be determined by Canada at the time of contract negotiation. This disclosure is made in good faith and does not commit Canada to contract for the total approximate funding. _____________ Challenge Details Challenge Title: W7714-248676/018 - Sustainable Northern Operations: Water & Waste The Department of National Defence and the Canadian Armed Forces (DND/CAF) are seeking novel, integrated technologies that enable the CAF to operate Relocatable Transportable Camps (RTCs) independently and sustainably in Arctic and sub-Arctic environments while meeting all applicable Canadian environmental and health regulations. Background and context The CAF’s strategic update Our North, Strong and Free (2024) directs an expansion of military operations in the Canadian North. RTCs deployed in remote Arctic regions must sustain personnel with safe water, sanitation, and waste-handling capabilities while minimizing logistics and environmental risk. In 2023, the IDEaS Pop-Up City contest demonstrated advanced, containerized power-water-waste systems. These prototypes significantly reduced solid-waste mass and potable-water demand but were not tested under Arctic winter conditions. Material brittleness, freezing of fluids, and power-efficiency issues remain key obstacles. This challenge will bridge this gap by developing, and then testing integrated cold-weather water and waste technologies under Arctic winter conditions (e.g., Op NANOOK). The objective of the challenge is to support the development of a proven, deployable, Canadian-made, Arctic-ready water-and-waste system enabling CAF RTCs to operate independently, safely, and sustainably in the North with drastically reduced logistics burden and environmental impact. Essential outcomes Proposed solutions must meet the following requirements: • Integrated capability combining water purification, wastewater treatment and solid-waste reduction suitable for camps of up to 50 personnel. • Use a modular design that allows transport by air or ship – ensuring that individual components fit within a standard 20 ft sea container with maximum dimensions of 108 in. (2.74 m) wide × 268 in. (6.81 m) long × 96 in. (2.44 m) high and a maximum weight of 24,000 lb (10,886 kg; 10.9 tonnes). The modular design must also enable on site assembly without the need for heavy lift equipment. • Treated outputs must meet or exceed Wastewater Systems Effluent Regulations and Health Canada Drinking-Water Guidelines. • Function continuously in remote northern locations and operate and withstand northern environmental conditions, including extreme cold down to -40°C. • Resource efficiency must be demonstrated through a reduction in resupply volume and frequency (fuel, water, consumables) by at least 75% from baseline (see Table 1 below). • Support maintainability and repairability in northern environments by ensuring that the solution can be serviced using common trades and tools available to CAF in deployed operations in remote areas. Desired outcomes Proposed solutions should include capabilities such as, but not limited to, the following: • Integrated power. • Operable in extreme heat conditions (up to +40°C). • No manual pre-processing of solid waste. • Recovery and reuse of waste-heat or by-products. • Can be scaled to suit camps of over 50 personnel, up to 1500 personnel. Table 1. Baseline for resources requirements for consumption and management per volume and frequency. Resource Volume and Frequency Potable water‡ 150 L / person / day Non-potable water 50 L / person / day Sewage – Black water 89.5 L / person / day Sewage – Grey water 48.5 L / person / day Solid waste – Dry* 1.1 kg / person / day Solid waste – Wet† 1.1 kg / person / day ‡ Water supplied to RTC at =4°C. 20% of potable water requirement (i.e. 30 L/person/day), is used as hot water at 60°C. * Total energy content can be assumed to be 15 MJ/kg. † Water content can be assumed to be 70%.

title: Netherlands – Supply services of personnel including temporary staff – Inhuur flexwerkers voor diverse Midwaste-leden
description: Aanbestedende dienst CV Midwaste Milieu UA (Midwaste) Poortweg 4 B 2612PA Delft Opdrachtgevers De Opdrachtgevers in deze aanbesteding zijn: - Afvalcombinatie 'De Vallei' Gemeenten BV - Afvalstoffendienst 's-Hertogenbosch - Regionaal Reinigingsbedrijf Avalex Den Haag - Dar NV Nijmegen - De Meerlanden Holding NV Rijsenhout - Saver NV Roosendaal Opdrachtomschrijving: Deze aanbesteding betreft een Europese openbare procedure voor de inhuur van flexwerkers ten behoeve van diverse leden van Midwaste. De opdracht omvat het ter beschikking stellen van flexwerkers, waarbij de aard, omvang en duur van de inzet kunnen verschillen per deelnemend Midwaste-lid. De specifieke kenmerken en behoeften worden nader toegelicht per perceel. Binnen deze aanbesteding zijn verschillende cao's van toepassing, afhankelijk van het betreffende Midwaste-lid. Opdrachtnemer houdt bij de uitvoering van de overeenkomst rekening met de voor het betreffende Midwaste-lid geldende cao en past, voor zover wettelijk en contractueel van toepassing, de daaruit voortvloeiende arbeidsvoorwaarden toe. Indien sprake is van overname van personeel, wordt verwacht dat de overgenomen medewerkers aansluiten bij de functie-indeling en loonschalen zoals deze binnen het betreffende Midwaste-lid worden gehanteerd. Doel van de opdracht: Met deze aanbesteding beogen de opdrachtgevers per perceel een duurzame samenwerking aan te gaan met een professionele dienstverlener die flexibel kan voorzien in de personeelsbehoefte van de deelnemende Midwaste-leden. Duur raamovereenkomst: De raamovereenkomsten treden in werking op 1 februari 2027 en hebben een initiële looptijd van twee jaar. Opdrachtgever heeft vervolgens de mogelijkheid de raamovereenkomsten viermaal (4) met een periode van twaalf (12) maanden te verlengen. Voor perceel 3 Afvalstoffendienst 's-Hertogenbosch geldt hierop een uitzondering: voor dit perceel bedraagt de verlengingsmogelijkheid tweemaal (2) een periode van twaalf (12) maanden.

title: Netherlands – Sewage, refuse, cleaning and environmental services – Europese openbare aanbesteding Bestrijden milieucalamiteiten en dumpingen op land en water
description: Europese openbare aanbesteding Bestrijden milieucalamiteiten en dumpingen op land en water. WSRL wil één aanspreekpunt voor milieucalamiteiten en dumpingen. Door het maken van duidelijke afspraken, wordt op eenduidige wijze met het bestrijden van milieucalamiteiten en dumpingen omgegaan. Opdrachtomschrijving De opdracht betreft het op afroep opruimen, inzamelen, transporteren, (laten) opslaan en (laten) verwerken van milieuverontreinigende stoffen en dumpingen op land en water in beheer in het beheergebied van WSRL, bij: Wegen en wegbermen (in Alblasserwaard en Vijfheerenlanden); Waterkeringen; Terreinen in eigendom van WSRL; Watergangen/-vaarwegen. Milieuverontreinigende stoffen zijn stoffen die schade kunnen toebrengen aan de leefomgeving, mens en/of milieu, bijvoorbeeld chemicaliën, oliën (inclusief brandstoffen) en asbestdeeltjes. Dumpingen zijn afvalstoffen die onbeheerd worden aangetroffen, bewust of onbewust (bijvoorbeeld bij een ongeval). Indien sprake is van (water)bodemverontreiniging dient Opdrachtnemer een milieukundig (water)bodemadvies (situationeel inclusief het nemen van waterkwaliteit monsters) uit te brengen waaruit blijkt of sanering op de calamiteitenlocatie noodzakelijk is. Mocht dat aan de orde zijn, dan draagt Opdrachtnemer zorg voor de uitvoering van de sanering. Indien Opdrachtnemer hier zelf niet voor erkend is, schakelt Opdrachtnemer een erkend onderaannemer hiervoor in. Opdrachtnemer is verantwoordelijk voor het eindresultaat. Het is van belang voor WSRL 24/7 – 365 dagen te beschikken over een gecontracteerde en daarmee gegarandeerde inzet van een Opdrachtnemer voor uitvoering van deze aanbestedingsopdracht. Na de melding van een calamiteit, verwacht WSRL van Inschrijver: 1. Door het stellen van de juiste vragen (doorvragen) aan de melder het zo volledig mogelijk inschatten van de situatie en bepalen van de te nemen maatregelen en in te zetten materieel en personeel; 2. Inschrijver neemt maatregelen om verdere verontreiniging, vervolgschade, uitbreiding en/of ecologische risico’s (risico’s ten aanzien van de leefomgeving, mens en milieu) van de calamiteit te voorkomen (De ter plaatse zijnde medewerker(s) van WSRL (meestal een handhaver) voeren vaak al kleine werkzaamheden uit, zoals oliebooms plaatsen op het water e.d.); 3. Het zorgdragen voor een veilige (verkeers)situatie en werkomgeving. Als het zelfstandig bestrijden van de calamiteit onmogelijk blijkt, moet Inschrijver de calamiteitlocatie alleen veiligstellen tot dat hulpdiensten en/of (andere) gespecialiseerde partijen ter plaatse zijn; 4. Indien de situatie hier om vraagt, voert Opdrachtnemer bij een spoedeisend karakter een milieukundig (water)bodemadvies en bodemsanering uit. Bij geen spoedeisend karakter heeft Opdrachtgever de mogelijkheid via een andere partij deze dienst af te nemen. Van Opdrachtnemer wordt in dat geval geen onderzoek of handeling daartoe vereist (zoals bijvoorbeeld het opstellen van de rapportage). Van spoedeisend karakter is sprake als (de kans op) milieuverontreiniging groter wordt; 5. Het uitvoeren van de werkzaamheden zo snel mogelijk afhandelen zodat het verkeer weer veilig en ongehinderd haar weg kan vervolgen; 6. Indien nodig uitvoeren van spoedeisende herstelwerkzaamheden aan/op de calamiteitenlocatie; 7. Situationeel leveren van schone grond (is grond en bodem dat volgens de huidige wetgeving mag worden toegepast); 8. Het op de juiste wijze afvoeren, transporteren, laten (opslaan) en (laten) verwerken van de milieuverontreinigende stoffen; 9. Opmaken van een opdrachtbevestiging over de calamiteit (24 uurs melding), milieukundig bodemadvies en/of rapportage bij (drugs)dumpingen; 10. Opdrachtgever gedurende de calamiteit en nazorg informeren over de uit te voeren/uitgevoerde calamiteitenbestrijding. Niet binnen de scope behoort: Het verwijderen van explosief en radioactief afval; Opdrachtgever voert het verhalen van schades op de verzekering van deze aanbestedingsopdracht zelf uit. Looptijd Raamovereenkomst Voor het bestrijden van milieucalamiteiten en dumpingen op land en water heeft WSRL het voornemen met één (1) Inschrijver een Raamovereenkomst aan te gaan voor een periode van twee (2) jaar. Optioneel is het mogelijk de Raamovereenkomst met een periode van tweemaal (2) één (1) jaar te verlengen onder gelijkblijvende voorwaarden. WSRL bepaalt uiteindelijk of de Raamovereenkomst al dan niet wordt verlengd. Tevens heeft WSRL de mogelijkheid de Raamovereenkomst eenzijdig te beëindigen. Het beëindigen van de Raamovereenkomst is door WSRL mogelijk als bij evaluatie herhaaldelijk blijkt dat Opdrachtnemer gemaakte afspraken niet naleeft en/of afgesproken kwaliteit niet levert. De Raamovereenkomst heeft daardoor een maximale looptijd van vier (4) jaar en eindigt, zonder dat opzegging vereist is, van rechtswege na het verstrijken van de vier (4) jaar. De ingangsdatum van de Raamovereenkomst is 1 december 2026 of zoveel eerder of later dat Opdrachtgever en Opdrachtnemer overeenkomen.

title: Denmark – Non-scheduled passenger transport – Udbud af kontrakt vedr. morskørsel til dansk politi
description: Dansk Politi udbyder kontrakt vedr. morskørsel. Delt op i fem (5) delaftaler: Delaftale 1: Morskørsel til Nordjyllands- og Midt- og Vestjyllands Politi Delaftale 2: Morskørsel til Østjyllands-, Sydøstjyllands- og Syd- og Sønderjyllands Politi Delaftale 3: Morskørsel til Fyns, Midt- og Vestsjællands og Sydsjælland og Lolland-Falsters Politi Delaftale 4: Morskørsel til Nordsjællands-, Københavns Vestegns- og Københavns Politi Delaftale 5: Morskørsel til Bornholms Politi Dansk politi har behov for kørsel af afdøde personer, der er erklæret for døde, og hvor dødsfaldet er omfattet af indberetningspligten jf. Sundhedslovens § 179, og hvor afdøde ikke ligger til offentligt skue. Kørslen omfatter to typer af kørsler, der skal udføres døgnet- og året rundt: 1. Almindelig morskørsel o Kørsel af afdøde fra opsamlingssted til et af politiets nærmere angivne steder. Dette kan eksempelvis være et kapel, et sygehus eller et retsmedicinsk institut, hvor der skal udføres et retslægeligt ligsyn. 2. Intern kørsel Udgangspunktet for Intern morskørsel er, at de kan planlægges mellem kunden og leverandøren. Intern kørsel bliver relevant i de situationer: o Hvor afdøde forud for dødens konstatering har været indbragt med ambulance til sygehus. Denne kørsel kan foregå mellem sygehus og kapel o Hvor der ved det retslægelige tilsyn vurderes, at der skal foretages obduktion. Denne kørsel består af to kørsler hhv. til retsmedicinsk institut og retur til udgangspunktet.

description: Předmětem plnění je výstavba silnice I/50 v nové trase kolem města Bučovice. Stavba začíná západně od města cca 50 m před křižovatkou se silnicí III/0506 do Maref v pasportním staničení km 17,690. Napojení stavby na původní trasu I/50 je na konci místní části Vícemilice v pasportním staničení km 23,530. Celková délka stavby činí 5570 m. Nová trasa silnice bude v počátečním a koncovém úseku vybudována jako směrově rozdělená dvoupruhová komunikace v návrhové kategorii S 11,5/90, zbývající středová část bude odpovídat kategorii S 13,5/90 (uspořádání 2+1) o délce 1990 m bez náběhových klínů. Nová trasa 2x kříží železniční trať a nachází se na ní 3 mimoúrovňové křižovatky, 6 mostů na silnici I/50, 1 most nad silnicí I/50, 2 mosty mimo silnici I/50, 3 opěrné zdi, které jsou řešeny jako samostatné stavební objekty. Součástí stavby je také vybudování 2 úrovňových křižovatek, 6 přeložek komunikací nižších kategorií, 2 příjezdy k retenčním nádržím, sjezdy a provizorní komunikace objízdných tras. Dále jsou nedílnou součástí stavby vodohospodářské objekty, přeložky dotčených inženýrských sítí, zřízení násypových těles, protihlukových stěn.

Die NES Wartung (SIP Service Platinum) beinhaltet Software und Firmware Updates innerhalb der gleichen Releases sowie Upgrades auf weitere Releases für Zähler, DC/DCN und NES System Software (Head End System), NES Provisioning Tool und NES Diagnostics Tool sowie Telefon und Web basierenden technischen Support. Aufgrund der bei IWB eingesetzten Software ist «SIP Platinum» oder gleichwertig erforderlich. IWB benötigt einen Reseller, der uns die Systemanpassungen gemäss SIP Platinum auf einem von IWB definierten Datenübergabepunkt für die kommenden vier Jahre (2027-2030) zur Verfügung stellt.

title: Poland – Processed vegetables – Dostawa przetworów warzywnych kwaszonych dla Jednostki Wojskowej Nr 6021.
description: Postępowanie prowadzone jest zgodnie z przepisami ustawy z dnia 11 września 2019 r. Prawo zamówień publicznych (Dz.U. z 2026 r. poz. 793) zwana dalej ustawą Pzp. Postępowanie prowadzone jest w trybie przetargu nieograniczonego zgodnie z art. 132 ustawy Pzp. Zamawiający udziela zamówienia w częściach, z których każda stanowi przedmiot odrębnego postępowania. Przedmiotem zamówienia jest dostawa przetworów warzywnych kwaszonych. Kod Wspólnego Słownika Zamówień (CPV): 15331000-7 Warzywa przetworzone Szczegółowy opis przedmiotu zamówienia określają załączniki nr 1, 1.1., 5 oraz nr 4 do SWZ tj.: Formularz ofertowy, Specyfikacja asortymentowo - cenowa, Opisy przedmiotów zamówienia oraz Projektowane postanowienia umowy. Zamawiający nie dopuszcza składanie ofert częściowych. Uzasadnienie: Zamawiający nie dopuszcza składania ofert częściowych, ponieważ przedmiot zamówienia obejmuje sukcesywne dostawy przetworów warzywnych kwaszonych, które wymagają zapewnienia ciągłości dostaw, jednolitego poziomu jakości oraz sprawnej organizacji i koordynacji realizacji zamówienia. Podział zamówienia na części i powierzenie ich realizacji kilku wykonawcom mógłby utrudnić bieżącą koordynację dostaw, w szczególności w zakresie terminów, ilości oraz jakości dostarczanych produktów. W przypadku wystąpienia braków, opóźnień lub konieczności wymiany produktów konieczne byłoby dodatkowe uzgadnianie działań pomiędzy Zamawiającym a poszczególnymi Wykonawcami, co mogłoby negatywnie wpłynąć na ciągłość zaopatrzenia. Ponadto dostawy realizowane przez różnych Wykonawców mogłyby wiązać się z różnicami w jakości oraz sposobie realizacji dostaw, co utrudniałoby zapewnienie jednolitych standardów wymaganych przez Zamawiającego. Podział zamówienia mógłby również powodować zwiększenie kosztów organizacyjnych i logistycznych, związanych m.in. z obsługą kilku umów, koordynacją wielu dostaw oraz kontrolą ich prawidłowej realizacji. Z uwagi na powyższe Zamawiający uznaje, że realizacja całości zamówienia przez jednego Wykonawcę zapewni sprawniejszą organizację dostaw, większą ciągłość i przewidywalność zaopatrzenia oraz jednolity standard jakości dostarczanych przetworów warzywnych kwaszonych, a także pozwoli ograniczyć koszty i ryzyka związane z koordynacją współpracy z wieloma Wykonawcami. Zamawiający wymaga złożenia oferty na wszystkie wymagane pozycje wykazane w załącznikach nr 1.1. do SWZ. Zamawiający w niniejszym postępowaniu przewiduje udzielenie zamówienia podstawowego (gwarantowanego) oraz ewentualnych zamówień w ramach Prawa Opcji. Informacje dotyczące zakresu zamówienia objętego Prawem Opcji, w tym zakres, termin skorzystania z tego uprawnienia przez Zamawiającego oraz zasady, na jakich będzie się to odbywało, zostały opisane w załączniku nr 4 do SWZ. Prawo Opcji jest uprawnieniem Zamawiającego, z którego może, ale nie musi, skorzystać w ramach niniejszego postępowania. Zamawiający nie ponosi żadnej odpowiedzialności z tytułu nieskierowania takiego żądania do Wykonawcy, a Wykonawcy z tytułu nie skorzystania z Prawa Opcji przez Zamawiającego nie przysługuje żadne roszczenie. Okoliczności skorzystania z opcji zostały opisane w § 3 w załączniku nr 4 do SWZ. Ilekroć w niniejszej SWZ przedmiot zamówienia jest opisany ze wskazaniem znaków towarowych, patentów lub pochodzenia, źródła lub szczególnego procesu, który charakteryzuje produkty dostarczane przez konkretnego Wykonawcę, jeżeli mogłoby to doprowadzić do uprzywilejowania lub wyeliminowania niektórych wykonawców lub produktów, to przyjmuje się, że wskazaniom takim towarzyszą wyrazy „lub równoważne”. Zamawiający, opisując przedmiot zamówienia, na podstawie dyspozycji wyrażonej w art. 99 ust. 4 ustawy Pzp, wskazał na znak towarowy lub pochodzenie z uwagi na specyfikę przedmiotu zamówienia oraz brak możliwości jego opisania w sposób wyczerpujący za pomocą dokładnych i zrozumiałych określeń. Opisując przedmiot zamówienia za pomocą znaków towarowych, patentów lub pochodzenia, źródła lub szczególnego procesu, który charakteryzuje produkty dostarczane Zamawiający określa tym samym parametry jakościowe, techniczne i cechy użytkowe, jakim musi odpowiadać przedmiot zamówienia, aby spełniać wymagania stawiane przez Zamawiającego. Przedmiot zamówienia powinien odpowiadać określonym przez Zamawiającego parametrom technicznym, funkcjonalnym i jakościowym wskazanym w opisie przedmiotu zamówienia, stanowiącym załącznik nr 5 do SWZ. Zamawiający nie zastrzega możliwości ubiegania się o udzielenie zamówienia wyłącznie przez Wykonawców, o których mowa w art. 94 ust. 1 ustawy Pzp, tj. mających status zakładu pracy chronionej, spółdzielnie socjalne oraz innych Wykonawców, których głównym celem lub głównym celem działalności ich wyodrębnionych organizacyjnie jednostek, które będą realizowały zamówienie, jest społeczna i zawodowa integracja osób społecznie marginalizowanych. Postępowanie prowadzone jest w języku polskim w formie elektronicznej za pośrednictwem platformazakupowa.pl pod adresem https://platformazakupowa.pl/pn/ozgst. Zamawiający informuje, że instrukcje korzystania z platformazakupowa.pl dotyczące w szczególności logowania, składania wniosków o wyjaśnienie treści SWZ, składania ofert oraz innych czynności podejmowanych w niniejszym postępowaniu przy użyciu platformazakupowa.pl znajdują się w zakładce „Instrukcje dla Wykonawców" na stronie internetowej pod adresem: https://platformazakupowa.pl/strona/45-instrukcje. Obzirom da su najave dolazaka i odlaska državljana trećih država iz Centra nepredvidljive, tom dinamikom se izvješćuje i ponuditelj, te naručitelj zadržava pravo , u slučaju žurnog postupanja, izmjene broja obroka do 8.00 sati dana kada se dostavlja ručak i večera, - ručak i večera – provodi se sukladno članku 19. Pravilnika o boravku u prihvatnom centru za strance. S obzirom da su državljani trećih zemalja koji su smještavani u Centru najčešće islamske vjeroispovijesti, ne treba isporučivati u prehrani svinjetinu, a ostalim korisnicima (npr. alergične osobe na neku hranu, trudnice ili bolesne osobe) se dogovara hrana prethodno sa ugovarateljem dostave hrane.
